title: Siege of Ragusa (1806)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Ragusa (1806)", at revision 1377523735, opens: "The siege of Ragusa took place in 1806 during the Napoleonic Wars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18199199, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1806 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
